atoms.evidence: is a prominent theoretical paper written by Johannes Sigil
The Inaugural Ark: Visual Compression and the Architecture of Recovery

The article analyzes "architectural compression"—the process of shrinking handwritten manuscripts into thumbnail grids so that the compositional rhythm and formal logic remain visible even when individual sentences become unreadable.
